Subject: Private VPC architecture review - next steps

Hi Jordan / Sam —

Thanks again for the call earlier — really helpful to understand Acme's primary goals for the private deployment (data residency, customer-isolated VPCs, and tighter network controls). Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: internal search & recommendations + customer-facing personalizations (low-latency inference).
- Data residency: production data must stay in Acme-managed VPC in us-west-2.
- Security controls: KMS/HSM required for keys, SOC2 evidence requested, and audit log retention 24 months.
- Expected QPS: ~50 concurrent requests peak; burst to 200 for promo periods.

Next step (recommended): 60-minute Private/VPC architecture review (technical deep-dive) to align on network topology, peering options (VPN vs Direct Connect), subnets, routing, and firewall requirements. Folks from our side who will join: Priyom (solutions engineer), Dev (security/ops), and me.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu Apr 15, 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM
- Fri Apr 16, 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM
- Mon Apr 19, 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM

Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (cloud/network engineer, security, and an exec if you'd like a short TL;DR). I attached our SOC2 summary and a draft mutual action plan to help prepare.

Also: if you can share a preliminary network diagram (VPC/subnets/IP ranges) ahead of the call that would help Priyom prepare targeted recommendations.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

I've attached the SOC2 summary again and the mutual action plan we referenced. Also attaching a meeting invite (.ics) so you can add to calendars. Priyom will prepare a short slide with topology examples (VPN vs Direct Connect + IP planning notes). Dev will be on for security/KMS questions.
